_metadata.description: Portal v0 foundation requirements linked to PRD operational targets.

requirements.title: Healthy Portal scaffold
requirements.description: Portal starts through the Vrooli scenario lifecycle, exposes API/UI/CLI health, and degrades cleanly when optional integrations are unavailable.

validation.notes: `vrooli scenario restart portal`, `cli-health validate scenario portal --json`, and `ui-health validate scenario portal --json` pass.

requirements.title: Chat-ready contract foundation
requirements.description: Portal owns typed Connect/proto seams for health, chat, message tree, integration status, and search suggestion behavior.

validation.notes: `proto-health validate scenario portal --json` and API/UI typechecks pass after proto generation.

requirements.title: OpenRouter chat path
requirements.description: Portal streams OpenRouter completions with model selection, optional web search, usage capture, and missing-key status instead of boot failure.

validation.notes: Live smoke demonstrates a streamed completion when `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` is set and degraded status when it is absent.

requirements.title: Agent-mode bridge
requirements.description: Portal can start and display agent-manager backed conversations without making agent-manager a required boot dependency.

validation.notes: Live smoke starts an agent-mode session when agent-manager is available and reports OFF/degraded status when it is not.

requirements.title: Passive ecosystem search
requirements.description: Portal requests search-hub suggestions and PASSIVE search attachments without blocking the LLM send path.

validation.notes: Live smoke shows the message send path proceeds immediately while search results attach asynchronously.

requirements.title: Readiness ladder controls
requirements.description: Portal measures optional integration readiness, applies OFF/PASSIVE/FULL-reserved policy, and surfaces override/status controls.

validation.notes: Live smoke demonstrates PASSIVE-to-OFF degradation and recovery for search-hub with the mode indicator visible.
